properties.name: pos.tax.test-mode.enabled
properties.description: Enable internal test-mode tax calculation behavior.

properties.name: pos.tax.test-mode.default-rates
properties.description: Default tax rates used in test mode by jurisdiction type.

properties.name: pos.tax.test-mode.jurisdictions
properties.description: Address-driven, effective-dated jurisdiction rate rules (story T7). Each rule matches on destination-address facets and carries its own rates, effective-from date, and optional per-category exemptions.

properties.name: pos.tax.provider
properties.description: Concrete external tax provider used when test mode is disabled: AVALARA (real AvaTax adapter) or EXTERNAL (legacy stub). Default/unset (TEST_MODE) resolves to the legacy external stub, preserving prior behavior.

properties.name: pos.tax.avalara.base-url
properties.description: Avalara AvaTax REST base URL. Sandbox https://sandbox-rest.avatax.com, production https://rest.avatax.com.

properties.name: pos.tax.avalara.account-id
properties.description: Avalara account id (HTTP Basic username). Env-var driven; empty until configured.

properties.name: pos.tax.avalara.license-key
properties.description: Avalara license key (HTTP Basic password). Secret, never logged. Env-var driven; empty until configured.

properties.name: pos.tax.avalara.company-code
properties.description: AvaTax company code used as the document company on every transaction.

properties.name: pos.tax.avalara.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout for AvaTax calls in milliseconds.

properties.name: pos.tax.avalara.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout for AvaTax calls in milliseconds.

properties.name: pos.tax.external-service.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for external tax provider API.

properties.name: pos.tax.external-service.api-key
properties.description: API key for external tax provider authentication.

properties.name: pos.tax.external-service.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout for external tax provider calls in milliseconds.

properties.name: pos.tax.external-service.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout for external tax provider calls in milliseconds.

properties.name: pos.tax.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum retry attempts for transient external tax call failures.

properties.name: pos.tax.retry.initial-backoff
properties.description: Initial backoff in milliseconds for external tax call retries.

properties.name: pos.tax.retry.multiplier
properties.description: Exponential backoff multiplier for external tax call retries.

properties.name: pos.events.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the pos-events/event-receiver API.

properties.name: pos.events.api-secret
properties.description: Shared secret used to authenticate event type registration requests.
